name: dbt-airflow-lineage
description: Interactive dbt lineage graph that also shows which Airflow pipelines run and ingest each model, resolving dbt selectors (tags, graph operators, excludes). Edit model YAML in place.

commands.title: dbt Airflow: Show Lineage for Current Model
dbt Airflow: Refresh (re-read manifest and DAGs)
dbt Airflow: Pipelines Triggering Current Model
dbt Airflow: Set up Airflow pipelines…
dbt Airflow: Sync Airflow DAGs from GCS

dbtAirflow.projectDir.description: dbt project dir (contains dbt_project.yml). Empty = auto-detect in the workspace.

dbtAirflow.manifestPath.description: Manifest path, relative to the dbt project dir.

dbtAirflow.airflowPaths.description: Absolute or workspace-relative directories holding Airflow DAG code (scanned recursively for .py).

dbtAirflow.dagsBucket.description: GCS folder that holds the Airflow DAGs when airflowSource is gcs, e.g. gs://my-bucket/dags. Uses gcloud with your own credentials.

dbtAirflow.upstreamDepth.description: How many levels upstream of the focused model are shown.

dbtAirflow.downstreamDepth.description: How many levels downstream of the focused model are shown.

enumDescriptions: Use "local" when airflowPaths is set, otherwise no Airflow pipelines.
Read DAGs from the folder(s) in airflowPaths.
Mirror DAGs from a Google Cloud Storage bucket (dagsBucket).
dbtAirflow.airflowSource.description: Where Airflow pipelines come from. Use "dbt Airflow: Set up Airflow pipelines…" for a guided setup.

dbtAirflow.dagsDownloadDir.description: Optional folder for the downloaded GCS DAGs. A sub-folder "airflow-dags-cache" is created there and is the only thing ever modified. Empty = extension storage.

dbtAirflow.dagsSyncExclude.description: Python regexes (matched against paths relative to the bucket folder) for objects NOT to download when syncing DAGs from GCS. The default copies only .py files and skips test and cache folders, which avoids downloading test data. Patterns cannot contain commas.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Airflow pipelines are optional. Connect a local DAGs folder or a Google Cloud Storage bucket to see which pipelines run each model.
[Set up Airflow pipelines](command:dbtAirflow.setupAirflow)
